2607.17191.title: Toward Anthropomorphic Dialogue: A Closed-Loop Framework for Human-Like Chat Generation, Evaluation, and Preference Alignment
2607.17191.paper_summary: Human-like private chat requires more than fluent response generation: a system must preserve persona, relationship, memory, bounded knowledge, medium-specific timing, and a coherent multi-turn arc. We present AnthroDial, a closed-loop framework that formulates anthropomorphic dialogue as a joint problem of system architecture, executable evaluation, and diagnostic alignment. It combines (1) a role-conditioned scheduled dialogue runtime with persona and scenario cards, long-term memory, virtual time, and single-draft message decisions; (2) an executable benchmark with an L0 validity gate, five per-turn dimensions, and five dialogue-level dimensions; and (3) a post-training pipeline that filters 16,436 scheduled-decision examples for SFT and applies GRPO with a cognitive-diagnostic, ZPD-aware reward. The reward maintains Kalman-filtered capability estimates for each behavioral dimension, upweights dimensions with larger capability deficits, and uses rollout scores as task-level ZPD matches to focus optimization on learnable weak skills. On a benchmark with 55 personas, 50 scenarios, 50 persona-scenario bindings, and 100 role-conditioned cases per model, we evaluate 16 systems spanning frontier baselines, open models, thinking/no-think variants, and SFT/RL ablations. The strongest non-trained baseline reaches 32.00% strict ACC, while Qwen3.6-27B-SFT+RL reaches 39.00% strict ACC and a 98.5 overall score. In the 9B no-think setting, SFT and RL improve strict ACC from 0.00% to 13.00% and 18.37%. These results show that anthropomorphic dialogue benefits when generation, evaluation, and reward shaping share the same behavioral dimensions.
2607.17191.paper_summary_zh: 人類般的私人聊天不僅需要流暢的回應生成：系統必須保持角色、關係、記憶、有限知識、媒介特定的時機和一致的多輪弧。我們提出了AnthroDial，一個將擬人化對話公式化為系統架構、可執行評估和診斷對齊的聯合問題的閉環框架。它結合了（1）一個角色條件的計劃對話運行時，配備角色和場景卡、長期記憶、虛擬時間和單次草稿消息決策；（2）一個可執行的基準，具有L0有效性閘、每輪五個維度和五個對話層級維度；以及（3）一個後訓練管道，過濾16,436個計劃決策範例以進行SFT，並應用GRPO，具有認知診斷和ZPD意識的獎勵。該獎勵保持每個行為維度的卡爾曼濾波能力估計，對能力缺口較大的維度進行加權，並使用回滾分數作為任務層級的ZPD匹配，將優化重點放在可學習的弱技能上。在一個擁有55個角色、50個場景、50個角色-場景綁定和每個模型100個角色條件案例的基準上，我們評估了16個系統，涵蓋前沿基準、開放模型、思考/不思考變體以及SFT/RL消融實驗。最強的非訓練基準達到32.00%的嚴格ACC，而Qwen3.6-27B-SFT+RL達到39.00%的嚴格ACC和98.5的總分。在9B不思考設置中，SFT和RL將嚴格ACC從0.00%提升至13.00%和18.37%。這些結果顯示，當生成、評估和獎勵塑造共享相同的行為維度時，擬人化對話會受益。
